text:
frank-ops: Heads-up: Vega G700 dedicated pools are entering GA soft-open next week. Regions: johannesburg-1 and seattle-4. Start: 2026-06-07 09:00 UTC. This rollout is GA but with constrained placement for new reserved accounts; please read the policy note below before scheduling migrations.

elaine-prod: GA? Does that mean production-safe / SLA-backed?

frank-ops: Short answer: partly. Pools are "GA: limited" 12 SLA (best-effort placement) will not be active for newly created reserved contracts until 2026-07-01. Existing reserved customers with contracts can request placement now. Treat this as a phased GA.

mike-eng: Quick perf/data point request 12 per-GPU mem + expected throughput vs H200?

frank-ops: G700 specs: 112GB VRAM, NVSwitch fabric, FP16 throughput ~1.9x H200 on long seq workloads in our bench. We'll publish a formal perf pack Monday.

infra-bot: System note: pools/vega-g700 class = "ga-limited". Placement priority: 1) existing reserved contracts 2) committed enterprise buckets 3) warm reservations within warm-window 4) ad-hoc. Preemptible cap = 20%.

sara-sre: Oncall/playbook: Vega racks use power profile P3. If you see brownouts or PSU alerts tag @sara-sre immediately. Runbook: intranet.redwood/runbooks/vega-g700 (internal).

compliance-bot: Compliance reminder: Only workloads that have completed the internal privacy review may run in johannesburg-1 until region data residency checks finish. Do not run regulated customer data until compliance clears the region.

elaine-prod: Billing / chargeback tag for initial GA tests?

frank-ops: Use charge tag: vega-ga-june2026 in reservation metadata. We'll add Console filters and billing mapping by EOD.

zoe-ps: Partner ops note: partners will get a small pool allocation for validation. We'll send opt-in invites tomorrow.

frank-ops: Reservation CLI snippet (copy/paste):
```
# reserve 2 GPUs in vega-g700 pool in seattle-4 for 3 hours starting 2026-06-07T09:00Z
rdrctl reserve --pool vega-g700 --region seattle-4 --count 2 --start 2026-06-07T09:00Z --duration 3h --meta "charge=vega-ga-june2026"
```

mike-eng: grabbing 2 for a latency sweep. Will post short results in #eng-runtime.

infra-bot: Reservation confirmed (id: 50211) for mike-eng 12 pool: vega-g700, region: seattle-4, start: 2026-06-07T09:00Z, duration: 3h.

sara-sre: Note for infra teams: firmware for G700 pinned to v2.0.1 for GA ramp. Do not upgrade without coord from frank-ops.

frank-ops: Policy change (important): warm-window default reduced to 90m for GA-limited pools to improve placement fairness across zones. If you need longer windows, include --warm-window override in reservation and attach a justification to the reservation meta. Abuse will be throttled.

elaine-prod: Got it. We'll wait for the perf pack before migrating critical workloads.

frank-ops: Thanks team 12 monitoring is enabled on Console > Dedicated > Pools > vega-g700. If you see anomalies open a ticket with label "vega-g700-ga" and tag @sara-sre.
